parrafo.es: Baker's Outside Services and Solutions trata céspedes, jardines y hasta árboles frutales y hortalizas con fertilizantes orgánicos, libres de químicos y pesticidas. Ryan revisa tu propiedad en persona, arma un plan a tu medida y da seguimiento mes a mes en Lakeland, Polk County y el área de Tampa Bay.
parrafo.en: Baker's Outside Services and Solutions treats lawns, landscapes and even fruit and vegetable plants with organic, chemical and pesticide free fertilizer. Ryan walks your property himself, builds a plan around what it needs, and follows up month after month across Lakeland, Polk County and the greater Tampa Bay area.

parrafo_1.es: Baker's Outside Services and Solutions es una empresa de Lakeland que atiende céspedes, jardines y hasta frutales y hortalizas con productos orgánicos, libres de químicos y pesticidas, incluyendo compost y té de compost hechos a mano.
parrafo_1.en: Baker's Outside Services and Solutions is a Lakeland company that treats lawns, landscapes and even fruit and vegetable plants with organic products, free of harsh chemicals and pesticides, including handmade compost and compost tea.

parrafo_2.es: El trabajo habla por sí solo: clientes que llevan hasta 3 años confiando en Ryan para el mantenimiento de su jardín lo describen como alguien que recorta y bordea todo por completo, y que salvó céspedes que ya se daban por perdidos.
parrafo_2.en: The work speaks for itself: clients who have trusted Ryan for up to 3 years of landscape maintenance describe him as someone who trims and edges everything completely, and who has brought lawns back from the brink.

texto.es: Llamas o escribes contándonos qué necesita tu césped o jardín. Ryan revisa el caso y te da una idea clara de cómo seguir.
texto.en: Call or message us and tell us what your lawn or landscape needs. Ryan looks at the situation and gives you a clear idea of how to move forward.

texto.es: Ryan visita tu propiedad, revisa suelo, plantas y riego, y te dice honestamente qué le hace falta a tu jardín.
texto.en: Ryan visits your property, checks the soil, plants and irrigation, and gives you an honest read on what your yard needs.

texto.es: Aplica fertilizante orgánico y libre de químicos, con un plan pensado para tu césped, tus camas de flores o tus frutales y hortalizas.
texto.en: He applies organic, chemical-free fertilizer with a plan built for your lawn, your flower beds, or your fruit and vegetable plants.

texto.es: Visitas mensuales o bimensuales mantienen tu jardín saludable, con Ryan dando seguimiento al progreso con el tiempo.
texto.en: Monthly or bi-monthly visits keep your yard healthy, with Ryan tracking the progress over time.

nota.es: Cada jardín se cotiza según su tamaño y lo que necesita. Llámanos y te damos el presupuesto sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every yard is quoted based on its size and what it needs. Call us and we will walk you through the price, no obligation.

texto.es: Tratamientos de fertilizante orgánico y libre de pesticidas que devuelven la vida a céspedes estresados o dañados.
texto.en: Organic, pesticide-free fertilizer treatments that bring stressed or struggling lawns back to life.

texto.es: Siembra, poda, mulch y flores de temporada para camas limpias y saludables todo el año.
texto.en: Planting, trimming, mulch and seasonal flowers for beds that stay clean and healthy year round.

texto.es: Reparación de sistemas de riego pensados para ahorrar agua, para que tu jardín reciba lo justo sin desperdicio.
texto.en: Waterwise irrigation repair so your system waters efficiently, without wasting a drop.

texto.es: El mismo cuidado orgánico extendido a árboles frutales y hortalizas, con compost y té de compost hechos a mano.
texto.en: The same organic care extended to fruit trees and vegetable gardens, with handmade compost and compost tea.

pie.es: ¿Tu jardín necesita algo distinto? Llámanos igual: seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Need something different for your yard? Call us anyway, we likely cover it.

items.quote: Delightful experience working with Ryan. My five flowerbeds were a mess and required not only lots of trimming but fertilizing as well. They now look terrific. He also filled my large garden pots with beautiful pansies for winter color.

We have been very happy with the great work Baker's Outside Services and Solutions has done for us. When we first started working with Ryan, our front lawn was nearly dead. Ryan saved our lawn's life! He has also done various other work for us.

We have used Ryan Baker's services for about 10 years. He is hard working, reliable, trust-worthy and great at communicating with me. He is always quick to respond to my calls or emails. I love that he uses products that are safe for my family.
